lines.en: Hello, everyone. Can I say my idea?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 여러분. 제 생각을 말해도 될까요?

lines.en: Of course. What is your opinion about the garden?
I think the team should clean it together.
Good idea. Every member can help on Saturday.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 토요일에 모든 구성원이 도울 수 있어요.

lines.en: Last year we discussed it but did nothing.
Don't worry. This time the result will be different.
lines.ko: 걱정하지 마세요. 이번에는 결과가 다를 거예요.

lines.en: What is our goal for the meeting?
A clean garden and flowers by next month.
I will bring tea for the team next Saturday.
lines.ko: 다음 주 토요일에 팀을 위해 차를 가져올게요.

lines.en: Thank you. We will work together and finish it.
Sir, what was the result of the meeting this morning?
lines.ko: 팀장님, 오늘 아침 회의 결과가 어땠어요?

lines.en: It went well. Everyone agreed after we discussed it.
lines.ko: 잘 됐어요. 논의한 뒤에 모두 동의했어요.

lines.en: That's great. What is our next task?
We will begin the new project on Monday.
Did the team like my idea today?
Yes. Your opinion helped everyone a lot today.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 당신 의견이 모두에게 큰 도움이 됐어요.

lines.en: I was worried about it all day.
Don't worry. We are a strong team together.
lines.ko: 걱정하지 마세요. 우리는 함께라서 강한 팀이에요.

lines.en: Thank you, Sir. I will write the results down.
Please do. We will discuss them again tomorrow.
lines.ko: 그렇게 해 주세요. 내일 다시 논의할 거예요.
